course_name_original: FONDAMENTI DI ALGEBRA E GEOMETRIA canale 1
course_name_en: FUNDAMENTALS OF ALGEBRA AND GEOMETRY channel 1

learning_outcomes.text: The student should be able to assimilate the acquired theoretical knowledge and develop or improve this capacity.

After assimilating basic vector calculus and matrix algebra, the student must be able to understand the links between endomorphisms and matrices and to master the problems of diagonalization of an endomorphism or a matrix.
The student must also know geometry in an affine space with particular attention to the Cartesian geometry of the plane and space.
The student should be able to acquire flexibility in exemplifying and solving various problems related to the theoretical knowledge acquired.

The student must be able to use this knowledge in operating with matrices, solving systems of linear equations, addressing issues concerning vector spaces and linear applications, and must be able to perform exercises related to the problem of diagonalization of endomorphisms and matrices.
The student must be able to apply the acquired knowledge in exemplifying a linear algebra problem through a numerical reformulation of it using matrices.
The course will tend to favor the student's ability to clearly and rigorously present the acquired knowledge, both theoretical and applied.
Students are guided to learn critically and responsibly everything explained in class and to enrich their judgment skills through the study of the didactic material indicated by the teacher.

degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
